name: kbd
title: Kbd
purpose: Present one keyboard key or a complete key chord as compact semantic input notation with a soft default material.
useFor: Key instructions inside actions or text
accessibility: An accessible label can expand symbolic chords.
Separators between supplied keys are decorative.
commonMistakes: Using Kbd as a clickable button.
Showing a shortcut the application does not implement.
Leaving a symbolic chord ambiguous to assistive technology.
